verdict.rationale: Column documents webhook endpoints, configurable via API or Dashboard, for notification of events [column-docs-7]. It also supports placing book transfers in a 'hold' state [column-docs-14] and overdraft-enabled negative balances [column-docs-15], which together suggest a ledger that tracks holds. However, the evidence does not show balance reads that break out held or pending amounts, nor does it confirm that every transaction state change emits a webhook. Missing for 10: documented balance fields (available vs. pending vs. hold), an enumerated event catalog covering all transfer state transitions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time mirroring.
